page: Microsoft Azure DC48ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCADSv5 server family. Powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server configuration includes 1843 GB of bundled local SSD storage, providing high-speed local data access. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the DC48ads_v5 offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads that require a steady ratio of compute to memory alongside substantial local storage. The combination of 48 dedicated vCPUs, 192.0 GB of RAM, and local SSD capacity makes this instance well-suited for relational databases, enterprise application hosting, data processing pipelines, and general-purpose business applications.
